info.name: METT-ElasticSearch-Extended
info.description:
Dataset maintenance queries against a METT Elasticsearch **release set**.

**Host:** `{{mett-elasticsearch-current}}` from the Postman environment (local / dev / prod files in `postman/`).

**Auth:** collection-level Basic `{{mett-elasticsearch-username}}` / `{{mett-elasticsearch-pass}}` — same secret-in-environment pattern as METT-DataPortal's `{{bearer-token-current}}`. Leave those env values empty in git; fill them in Postman.

**Indexes:** collection variables `index-*` default to `mett-{{mett-release}}-{family}`. Change `mett-release` or override a single `index-*` (legacy `feature_index`, or a concrete `mett-v1-g001-features`).

Use **METT-ElasticSearch** for smoke expected-totals. This collection is for inventory, species/strain visibility, and ingest quality checks.

Species/strain enable/disable writes Elasticsearch only; call DataPortal `POST /api/admin/cache/rebuild` (admin JWT) so in-memory visibility registries reload.

item.name: Species visibility

request.description: Portal APIs only return `enabled=true`. This lists every species document.
Species `_id` is the acronym. Defaults to `species_acronym_toggle` so BU/PV are not used for enable/disable tests.
Sets `enabled=true` on one species document. This does **not** refresh the Django in-memory species registry; call DataPortal `POST /api/admin/cache/rebuild` after changing visibility.
Sets `enabled=false` on `{{species_acronym_toggle}}`.
Enables every acronym in `species_acronyms_bulk` (comma-separated). Does not touch BU/PV unless those acronyms are in the list.
Disables every acronym in `species_acronyms_bulk`.

item.description: Toggle `enabled` on species documents. Single updates use `species_acronym_toggle`; bulk updates use `species_acronyms_bulk`. After ES changes, call DataPortal `POST /api/admin/cache/rebuild` (admin JWT) so in-memory species registries reload.

item.name: Strain visibility

request.description: Portal genome/gene APIs hide strains with `enabled=false` (and those whose species is disabled). This lists every strain document with enablement counts.
Strain `_id` is the isolate name. Defaults to `isolate_name_toggle` so BU_ATCC8492 / PV_ATCC8482 are not used for enable/disable tests.
Sets `enabled=true` on one strain document. This does **not** refresh the Django in-memory strain registry; call DataPortal `POST /api/admin/cache/rebuild` after changing visibility.
Sets `enabled=false` on `{{isolate_name_toggle}}`.
Enables every isolate in `isolate_names_bulk` (comma-separated). Matches strain `_id` values. Does not touch BU_ATCC8492 / PV_ATCC8482 unless those names are in the list.
Disables every isolate in `isolate_names_bulk`.

item.description: Toggle `enabled` on strain documents. Single updates use `isolate_name_toggle`; bulk updates use `isolate_names_bulk`. After ES changes, call DataPortal `POST /api/admin/cache/rebuild` (admin JWT) so in-memory strain registries reload.
